purpose: Track protein-structure, AlphaFold, and stability feature coverage for Point E.
role: Feature engineering only; not a variant source and not a clinical label source.

alphafold_db.purpose: Model metadata, pLDDT confidence, PAE links, model URLs

rosetta_cartesian_ddg.purpose: More computationally expensive mutation delta-delta-G candidate

freesasa.purpose: Relative solvent accessibility and buried/core flags

uniprot_pfam_interpro.purpose: Domains, repeats, functional sites, and region annotations

qc_rules: Do not infer protein-position features without validated transcript-to-UniProt mapping.
Wild-type amino acid must match the selected UniProt sequence before residue-level features are trusted.
Missense variants are the primary target for residue pLDDT and delta-delta-G.
Do not compute missense delta-delta-G for synonymous, intronic, UTR, or splice-only variants.
Do not mix delta-delta-G engines without recording ddg_method.
Every output must include source-specific status and missing-reason columns.
Low-pLDDT residues must be flagged so structural features are not overinterpreted.
